title: Require Civ7 API Materializer Structure
forbids: an open materializer source or proof cabinet that can mix acquisition, generated authority, or unrelated host logic
why: Official knowledge is only trustworthy when one finite host realization owns source identity, exact snapshot replacement, and its semantic proof while the generated package remains separate.
remediate: Keep the materializer inside its closed source and semantics members; move generated authority to packages/civ7-api and unrelated host capabilities to their rightful owners.
message: The Civ7 API materializer must preserve its closed product-qualified source and proof topology.
